Name: Grid Reference Data Extension
Description: The geographic location of each pixel may be derived from a given set of location grids computed for a given elevation when the image, matrix, or raster data is not rectified. The user-defined fields of the GRDPS extension are detailed in Table P-4. A single GRDPS is placed in the Image Subheader. The coordinates expressed in the location grids refer to the absolute coordinate system defined in GEOPS (and possibly PRJPS).

NUM_GRDS.Name: Number of Location Grids
NUM_GRDS.Description: This field defines the number of location grids described in the GRDPSB extension. Usually, only one or two grids are needed.

ZVL<NUM_GRDS>.Name: Location Grid Elevation
ZVL<NUM_GRDS>.Description: This field shall contain the elevation (meters) to which the nth location grid has been computed, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if this elevation is not useful (a single grid is provided, for example). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

BAD<NUM_GRDS>.Name: Location Grid ID
BAD<NUM_GRDS>.Description: This field shall contain the identification of the Image Segment (IID1 field) which contains the nth location grid data.

LOD<NUM_GRDS>.Name: Data Density in Columns
LOD<NUM_GRDS>.Description: This field shall contain the interval (measured in image pixels) between two consecutive elements of the nth location grid (in columns). Positive (decimal or integer) values are required.

LAD<NUM_GRDS>.Name: Data Density in Rows
LAD<NUM_GRDS>.Description: This field shall contain the interval (measured in image pixels) between two consecutive elements of the nth location grid (in rows). Positive (decimal or integer) values are required.

LSO<NUM_GRDS>.Name: Origin in Columns
LSO<NUM_GRDS>.Description: This field shall contain the column number of the origin of the nth location grid.

PSO<NUM_GRDS>.Name: Origin in Rows
PSO<NUM_GRDS>.Description: This field shall contain the row number of the origin of the nth location grid.
